title: [Bug] Session limit reached prematurely on Pro Plan despite low usage
body:
**Bug Description**
Hi i just started with Claude Code and ir works really well. 
But there is a big Problem. Although i am on the Pro Plan, I barely work with the system and reach my session limits within a very short time.
My Colleague reports that he never sees the limits reached although he is on the same plan.
Can you pls check if there is anything wrong with my setup?
Thanks!

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 2.1.1
- Feedback ID: 7d42b856-1ebf-47d7-80b4-885dc7c57578
